title: Frozen seven-core synthetic input candidate
status: APPROVED CANDIDATE DISTRIBUTION. No training or corpus launch authorized.
hypothesis: A bounded mixture of stochastic, switching, spatial and oscillatory dependencies may supply useful reconstruction pretraining tasks.
null: Simple stochastic inputs or no synthetic pretraining may work equally well or better. Visual resemblance and moment matching do not decide this.

core_sampling.implementation: candidate_sampling_identity.plan_worlds: randomly ordered balanced eight-world blocks; each of six cores once and oscillator twice.
core_sampling.interpretation: Design weights for coverage, not inferred biological prevalence or evidence that seven cores beat fewer.

hierarchy.world: One independent core seed, source maps, spatial/source gains, spectral tendencies and continuous trajectory. Full virtual source lattice 12x23.
hierarchy.recording: One profile and one observed contact coverage per world in the primary sampler. Parameters stay fixed throughout the recording.
hierarchy.within_recording: Existing core trajectories and source envelopes evolve continuously; no framewise parameter redraw.
hierarchy.paired_views: Retain renderer capability for counterfactual diagnostics; do not multiply primary-corpus world counts with repeated views.

inherited.rationale: Weaker HGA gain and reduced explicit coupling follow v9/v10 diagnostics. Spatial/drive intervals are bounded engineering diversity, not identified neural parameters. Extra global gain remains excluded.
excluded: clinical artifacts without an explicit validated prior

coverage.masks: coverage-masks.json; source_row=origin[0]+positions[i][0], source_col=origin[1]+positions[i][1]; contact order retained.

observation_prior.noise: IID standard-normal float32 voltage noise on the full source lattice, multiplied by recording RMS. Independent seed per world/recording; no added clinical artifact model.
observation_prior.order: Build latent/source voltage -> mix full source lattice -> add recording noise -> select contacts -> CAR/filter -> canonical STFT -> frozen per-recording normalization -> G3.
observation_prior.limits: Two contact masks and a bounded prior are a limited engineering support, not a fitted patient/hardware population model.
observation_prior.effective_width_precedence: Recording widths are authoritative. Legacy source settings contain unused sampled width fields retained solely for exact source-seed provenance.

source_and_frontend.source_details: Pinned source is authoritative for source maps, rhythms, carrier spectrum, gains and offline trajectory standardization. Core parameters, initial states and sampled arrays must be retained.

frontend.normalizer: per-contact/bin lower median and 1.4826 lower MAD; floor 1e-6
frontend.g3: clip normalized content to [-15,15]; complete synthetic availability

session.statistical_scope: offline world; generator field standardization uses the simulated trajectory. This is not a causal online simulator.

audited_portable_renderer_archive.scope: All eight source worlds and sixteen cached packets replayed exactly. Frozen independent-noise corpus has not been rendered.

identity_and_split.world_planner: Existing v13 identity planner; exact 128-bit lowercase hex strings, never JSON numeric seeds.
identity_and_split.world_group: world/<family>/<core_seed_hex>; every observation and crop of that world belongs to one split.
identity_and_split.recording_addresses: candidate-corpus-recording1: SHA256 canonical JSON [namespace,purpose,world_group_id,0], first32hex; independent profile/rms/coverage/unit-noise purposes.
identity_and_split.implementation_state: Metadata sampler implemented and validated. No waveform generation or model training.
identity_and_split.namespace_policy: Reserve fresh future_train/future_valid worlds; current public and qualification worlds are diagnostics and not reused as the candidate training corpus.
identity_and_split.checks: Reject duplicate world IDs, core streams and seed streams across splits; retain realized rule fingerprints, source arrays, renderer settings and normalizer provenance.

shared_gain.decision: Leave disabled: core-dependent spatial/temporal trade-off; switching lag outlier and local-field nonresponse.

evidence.references: Previously exposed SOURCE development statistics. S14 legacy and S62 HELD visual checks do not select priors. No VALID/TEST tuning.

limits: No learned representation, semantics, physiological identification or transfer evidence.
Repeated manual tuning against a few reference recordings risks generator/diagnostic overfitting.
Wider HGA mixing improves adjacent correlation here; distant and temporal mismatches remain.
One or two worlds per core do not establish a family distribution or robust ranking.
No independent subject-level realism confirmation and no universal biological acceptance threshold.
Frozen short-prefix synthetic normalization is not identical in sampling scope to complete real TRAIN normalization.

scope.requested_next_action: Specification and metadata sampler frozen. Any training/corpus size and launch require a separate contract.
not_authorized: Further renderer tuning without a new scientific contract
scope.rationale: A distribution can be specified before choosing how many samples or optimizer steps to draw. The final training contract must bind those quantities separately.
scope.adoption_scope: This synthetic candidate only. No production model, real-data preprocessing, training objective or evaluation contract changed.

alternatives.retain_original_hga_width: Preserves the original prior; retains the repeatedly observed adjacent-correlation deficit. Keep as comparison, not silently discard.
alternatives.simplify_core_assortment: Possible linear/switching/local pilot, but that changes the agreed mixture and requires explicit review; no evidence yet establishes it as superior.

stop_rule: Freeze this candidate distribution for the first matched learning test if approved; do not tune it further using the same development references. Any later change gets a new explicit scientific contract.
approved_changes: Choose extra HGA mixing sigma 0.65 rather than the original uniform[0.25,0.65].
Use one recording profile and one coverage per new independent source world in the primary corpus; keep paired views for diagnostics.
Use independently addressed recording-noise realizations, rather than the shared unit-noise field used for matched controls.
